errors.reasonRequired: A reason is required for {action} in this server.
errors.notAMember: That user isn't a member of this server.
errors.tempBanDisabled: Temporary bans are turned off in this server's settings — use a permanent ban or enable temp bans.
errors.invalidUserId: That doesn't look like a valid Discord user id.
errors.messageContentDisabled: Filtering by message text isn't available — this server hasn't enabled message content access. Purge without the "contains" filter, or filter by user instead.
errors.noChannel: I couldn't determine which channel to use.
errors.invalidSlowmode: Slowmode must be "off" or a number of seconds between 0 and 21600 (6 hours).
errors.roleTooHigh: I can't manage that role — it's above (or equal to) my highest role.

confirm.title: Confirm this action
confirm.ban: Ban {user}? This removes them from the server.
confirm.softban: Softban {user}? They'll be banned and immediately unbanned to clear recent messages.
confirm.purge: Delete {count} message(s)? This can't be undone.
confirm.roleAdd: Add {role} to {user}? This role grants elevated permissions.
confirm.roleRemove: Remove {role} from {user}? This role grants elevated permissions.

purge.failed: I couldn't delete those messages. Please try again in a moment.
purge.failedMissingPermission: I couldn't delete those messages. I need Manage Messages and Read Message History in this channel.
purge.failedChannelGone: I couldn't delete those messages because this channel was deleted.
purge.failedMessagesGone: Some of those messages were already deleted, so I couldn't finish the purge. Run it again to clear the rest.

appealSetup.success: Appeals will now be posted to {channel}.

appeal.notYours: You can only appeal your own cases.
appeal.submitted: Your appeal has been submitted. Staff will review it soon.
appeal.notRoutedTitle: Appeal saved — but staff weren't notified
appeal.notRouted: Your appeal was recorded, but this server has no appeals channel set up (or I can't post in the one it has), so no one has been alerted. Contact a moderator directly if you need it looked at.

embeds.noticeAppealHint: If you believe this was a mistake, you can appeal with `/appeal {number}` in the server.
